- Warm up with 5 minutes of jumping jacks

Sure, I can provide a more rigorous workout routine that is specifically designed to help you lose belly fat. Here's a 4-day a week workout plan that you can try at home with no weights or equipment:

Day 1: Cardio and Core
Warm up with 5 minutes of jumping jacks
- 20 seconds of burpees followed by 10 seconds of rest
- 20 seconds of high knees followed by 10 seconds of rest
- 20 seconds of jumping jacks followed by 10 seconds of rest
- 20 seconds of mountain climbers followed by 10 seconds of rest
- 20 seconds of bicycle crunches followed by 10 seconds of rest
- Repeat this circuit 4 times
- Do 3 sets of 30 seconds of plank, 20 leg raises, and 20 Russian twists

Day 2: Lower Body
Warm up with 5 minutes of jumping jacks
- 20 side to side jumps followed by 10 seconds of rest
- 20 jump squats followed by 10 seconds of rest
- 20 jump lunges followed by 10 seconds of rest
- 20 mountain climbers followed by 10 seconds of rest
- Repeat this circuit 4 times
- Do 3 sets of 20 sumo squats, 20 reverse lunges, and 10 jump squats

Day 3: Upper Body and Core
Warm up with 5 minutes of jumping jacks
- 20 pushups followed by 10 seconds of rest
- 20 dips followed by 10 seconds of rest
- 20 tricep extensions followed by 10 seconds of rest
- 20 bicep curls followed by 10 seconds of rest
- Repeat this circuit 4 times
- Do 3 sets of 20 plank jacks, 20 mountain climbers, and 20 oblique twist

Day 4: HIIT and Abs
Warm up with 5 minutes of jumping jacks
- 20 seconds of squat jumps followed by 10 seconds of rest
- 20 seconds of jumping lunges followed by 10 seconds of rest
- 20 seconds of high knees followed by 10 seconds of rest
- 20 seconds of bicycle crunches followed by 10 seconds of rest
- Repeat this circuit 4 times
- Do 3 sets of 20 leg raises, 20 Russian twists, and 20 flutter kicks

Remember to always warm up before exercising and cool down after each workout routine. Increase intensity or reps as you progress through the weeks to continue challenging your body. Drink plenty of water and consult with a healthcare professional before starting any new exercise or diet plan. Good luck on your weight loss journey!
